name: Recall checker

product.purpose: Check reseller inventory against current public recalls and provide the official notice for review.
channels: thrift and consignment store inventory CSV
product.publication: Recall pages are generated locally. The owner reviews the first 50 and submits any Chrome Web Store listing; no page or extension is published automatically.
product.billing: Individual and store plan ranges and a free single-lookup tier are in plans.json. The owner configures Stripe test prices before checkout links are offered; API metering is not activated until the owner sets a price.

schedules.purpose: Refresh recall feeds and rebuild local, source-linked recall pages.

your_steps.title: Review the first 50 recall pages
your_steps.when: Before placing any recall pages on a public site
your_steps.detail: Open the generated local pages, verify the recall number, date and official source link, then approve or correct them. Glacier generates the pages but does not publish them.

your_steps.title: Submit the Chrome extension listing
your_steps.when: When the extension package and store listing are ready
your_steps.detail: Review permissions, privacy text and screenshots, then sign in and submit the package to the Chrome Web Store. Glacier does not create an account or submit it.

your_steps.title: Set up test prices and review plan wording
your_steps.when: Before offering paid plans or API access
your_steps.detail: Configure Stripe test price IDs in Glacier Secrets, review individual and store plan amounts, and choose a metered API price. Live billing remains disabled until you configure it yourself.

launch_gates: The labeled 500-known-recalled and 500-known-clean benchmark meets the at-most-1% false-no-match gate before an update is released.
The owner reviews the first 50 recall pages before public hosting.
The owner submits the first Chrome Web Store listing.
